collision_policy.changed_mechanic: Add the restored record; retain narrower/migrated current mechanics unless an explicit future supersession is published.
collision_policy.current_only_nonselectable: Retain as nonselectable source concepts; do not delete to force a selectable total.
collision_policy.duplicate_source_occurrence: Deduplicate selection and compilation by stable ID while preserving all source occurrence provenance.
collision_policy.same_display_name_different_ids: Require owning group/type in owner presentation and stable ID in diagnostics.
